title: Cat Stays Home
description: Want your cat to just stay home? Don't want to keep him sitting there forever? This mod will solve your problem! Right-clicking on your cat while crouched will allow you to toggle his behavior, allowing or disabling him from teleporting to you.
body:
Want your cat to just stay home? Don't want to keep him sitting there forever? This mod will solve your problem! Right-clicking on your cat while crouched will allow you to toggle his behavior, allowing or disabling him from teleporting to you.
![Cat won't teleport to you](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce8806a83c3791cd24583de479d4668cbc75630f_0.webp)
![Cat will teleport to you](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0458eae25bf2c58b8220d27020d2a80276e6bb60_0.webp)
